scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:root: podman exec -it studio_db_central psql -U studio_root -d postgres
scripts.db:list: podman exec studio_db_central psql -U studio_root -d postgres -c '\l'
scripts.db:usage: podman exec studio_db_central psql -U studio_root -d postgres -c 'SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) FROM pg_database'
